findings.summary: ProjectScope semantic-change invalidation derives TargetBinding dependencies from NodeRun.node_id equality instead of the durable graph dependency semantics.
findings.evidence: storage/graph_engineering/storage/repository.py:417-425 selects a run only when record.node_id equals target_id. The remedy test manufactures node_id=target-third. An independent target_id!=node_id repro changed target-third while a ready implementation run existed and observed emitted run_ids=[], stored run_dependencies=[{target_id:target-third,run_ids:[]}], and the implementation run remained ready. GraphDefinition defines independent node invalidation_tags and edge invalidation_rule, and the approved Spec requires downstream invalidation through the TargetBinding dependency graph.
findings.required_change: Persist or deterministically resolve an explicit TargetBinding-to-node/run dependency from the approved graph semantics, traverse the affected downstream edges, and emit the exact affected run IDs without relying on node ID and target ID equality.
findings.verification: Add a production-path negative test where target_id differs from node_id, the node is explicitly bound to that target by the approved graph dependency/invalidation metadata, and a semantic target change invalidates that run plus the exact downstream closure while leaving unrelated runs unchanged. Reject missing, stale, substituted, or ambiguous dependency metadata with zero writes.
